Select approved drugs indicated for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication and map indication details to EFO terms. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for max_phase_for_ind = 4 and mesh_heading matching 'type 2 diabetes mellitus'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
